newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PARMA'S BUCCI INTERESTED IN ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARMA'S BUCCI INTERESTED IN ENGLAND.

text.p: Former Italy goalkeeper Luca Bucci said on Wednesday he wanted to leave Parma and was interested in a possible move to England.
"I would be very pleased to spend some time in England," Bucci told reporters.
Italian newspapers have mentioned Derby County, Leeds and Middlesbrough as interested clubs.
Bucci, 27, capped three times for Italy, has been dropped as Parma's first-choice goalkeeper in favour of Gianluigi Buffon since November.

He has been linked to other Italian clubs. Perugia, now coached by former Parma boss Nevio Scala and with four other former Parma players in the squad, has also been seen as a likely destination if Parma allow him to go.
